title: Enriques' characterization of Abelian surfaces in positive characteristic
summary: Extending Enriques' characterization to algebraically closed fields of characteristic $p \geq 7$, we show that every smooth projective surface $X$ with $h^1(X, \mathcal{O}_X) = 2$ and $p_1(X) = p_2(X) = 1$ is birational to an Abelian surface. This characterization fails if $p \leq 5$, and we give a sharp alternative.
